# MAAC Animation Institute Jaipur
> Rajasthan's #1 Animation, VFX & Game Design Institute — 30+ years of educational excellence.

## About
MAAC Jaipur C-Scheme is Rajasthan's leading Animation, VFX and Game Design institute. We offer B.Voc degrees (UGC-recognized), diploma programs, and short-term certificate courses. NSDC & MESC certified with 95% placement support.

## Courses
- 3D Animation (AD3D Edge, D3D) — 12-24 months
- Visual Effects (ADVFX, VFX Plus) — 6-12 months
- Game Design & Integration (DGDI) — 12 months
- Digital Filmmaking (DFM, DAFM) — 12 months
- Digital Media & Design (APDMD) — 24 months
- Graphic Design — 6-12 months
- B.Voc in 3D Animation & VFX — 3 years
- Short-term: Maya Pro, Max Pro, CE Pro — 3-6 months
